summary: The Pay Our Military Act of 2025 provides funding for military pay, allowances, and specific benefits during any government shutdown period in fiscal year 2026 where full-year or continuing appropriations are not in effect. It also covers certain Department of Defense and Coast Guard civilian personnel and contractors who support active service members.

affected_groups.effect: Receive pay, allowances, clothing, subsistence, and other listed benefits during a government shutdown while performing active service.
affected_groups.group: Members of the Armed Forces and Reserve Components

affected_groups.effect: Receive monthly payments if they are caring for a child of a member or former member of the Armed Forces.
Receive pay and allowances if determined to be providing support to active service members during a shutdown.
affected_groups.group: Department of Defense and Coast Guard Civilian Personnel

affected_groups.effect: Receive payments if determined to be providing support to active service members during a shutdown.
affected_groups.group: Department of Defense and Coast Guard Contractors

key_provisions: Appropriates funds for pay, allowances, clothing, subsistence, interest on deposits, gratuities, and permanent change of station travel for members of the Armed Forces and reserve components performing active service.
Provides funds for monthly payments to surviving spouses caring for a child of a member or former member of the Armed Forces.
Appropriates pay and allowances for Department of Defense and Coast Guard civilian personnel determined to be providing support to active service members.
Provides payments for Department of Defense and Coast Guard contractors supporting active service members.
Prohibits agencies from using these funds during any period when other continuing appropriations are already available for the same purposes.
Terminates funding upon the enactment of specified appropriations legislation or on September 30, 2026, whichever comes first.
Takes effect retroactively as if enacted on September 30, 2025.
missing_information: The total exact dollar amount required to fund these provisions is not specified in the text.
Specific criteria or methods for how the Secretary concerned determines which civilian personnel and contractors are 'providing support' are not detailed in the text.
summary_detail.plain_summary: The Pay Our Military Act of 2025 provides funding for military pay, allowances, and specific benefits during any government shutdown period in fiscal year 2026 where full-year or continuing appropriations are not in effect. It also covers certain Department of Defense and Coast Guard civilian personnel and contractors who support active service members.
summary_detail.significance: The bill ensures continuous funding for military pay and select supporting personnel and contractors during lapses in regular government appropriations, maintaining financial operations for covered defense and Coast Guard personnel through September 30, 2026, or until regular appropriations are enacted.
